meta.title: Pricing - NIS2 Compliance Platform
meta.description: The platform is free, permanently. Hosted at nisd2.eu, or self-hosted on your own infrastructure, source open under AGPL-3.0. No contract, no activation, no lock-in.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Free, permanently. The only choice is who runs it.

free.name: Hosted at nisd2.eu
free.description: The full platform, operated by us on EU infrastructure.

features.f1: All 49 BSIG requirements step by step
features.f3: PDF export for auditors and management
features.f10: No lock-in. Open data model. Export anytime, including into self-hosting.

meta.title: Pricing: the NIS 2 guided pass and self-hosting
meta.description: The NIS 2 guided pass at nisd2.eu: {price} net a year, by invoice, 30 days money back, any number of organizations and users. Self-host under AGPL-3.0.

paid.subtitle: One offer at nisd2.eu, one price. Or run the open source yourself.
paid.name: NIS 2 guided pass
paid.description: A yearly licence at nisd2.eu, operated by us. One payment covers every organization and user on your account.
paid.terms: You pay by invoice within 30 days. If you cancel within 30 days of ordering, you get your money back.
paid.courseLine: For management, there is the NIS 2 course.

features.p1: The NIS 2 requirements step by step, with status, evidence and approval for each one
features.p2: Upload evidence and file it against the requirement it proves
features.p4: Registers for assets, risks and suppliers
features.p5: Deadlines and review dates for each requirement
features.p6: Any number of organizations and users on one payment

paid.delivery: You get today's journey straight away, and the guided form when it is ready, within the same paid year.
paid.grandfathered: Anyone who signed in at least once before paid access started keeps today's journey without paying for it. For them the paid year costs {price} net.
paid.whyFree: Why self-hosting costs nothing: the source is open on GitHub, auditable and yours to run. What you pay for is us running it at nisd2.eu.

selfHost.name: Self-host
selfHost.description: Full source code. On your own infrastructure, permanently.

features.h1: Full platform source, open under AGPL-3.0
features.h3: On your own infrastructure, with your own data
features.h4: No contract, no activation key, no account with us
features.h5: Export your work from nisd2.eu and carry on running it yourself
features.h6: Direct contact by email and Signal
features.h7: Setup by us if you want it: €500 net, one-time

pricing.whyFree: Why free: the source is open on GitHub, auditable and yours to run. We charge for setting up self-hosted installations, and we take a commission from the specialist firms we refer you to. Not for the platform.
pricing.consultantFootnote: Stuck with NIS 2? Short technical questions cost nothing, and if it needs a specialist firm, we refer you to one at no cost to you.
